changelog: Programs on a published channel now follow each other smoothly. The next program is put into the client's own queue as soon as one starts playing, so the channel rolls on from there instead of dropping back to the menu for a moment while the server sends the next one. Should a client ignore the queue, the server still steps in as before.
description: Lightweight virtual TV channels: deterministic schedules over your own library, tuned in via normal direct playback at the live position. No transcoding, no tuner emulation.
name: LiteTV Channels
overview: TV channels from your library, without transcoding.
